description: Read one annual report (XBRL) of a Danish company and return its key figures for that year and the year before: revenue, gross profit, operating profit, profit, equity, assets, cash, employees, plus company name, period, currency and auditor. Use it for one year's headline numbers; use get_financials_history for a trend over several years and get_report_facts for any other line item. Group reports default to the consolidated group. Values are in the filing's currency (usually DKK); a missing figure is null and notes say why (small companies may legally omit revenue). found=false when the company has no machine-readable annual report for that year.

cvr.description: Danish CVR number, 8 digits (spaces, dashes and a DK prefix are accepted), e.g. "24256790".

scope.description: For group reports (koncernregnskab): "group" = the consolidated group, "parent" = the parent company alone. Ignored for single companies.

year.description: Calendar year the reporting period ends in (a 2024/25 financial year ending June 2025 is 2025). Omit for the latest annual report.

name: get_financials

figures.description: Key figures; current = this report's year, previous = the year before.

message.description: Why nothing was found (only when found=false).

notes.description: Gaps, conflicts and caveats found in the filing, in plain English.

scope.description: Whose figures these are; "company" for a report without a group.

source.description: The filing document the figures were read from.

title: Get key financials from an annual report
